# Ascent B Site 3D architectural study

This is a **real editable 3D environment**, not an extruded minimap. It includes multiple buildings, sloped roofs, a courtyard, arch, shutter, stairs, market threshold, walls and green-lit cover props.

## Open it
- Blender: File > Import > glTF 2.0 (.glb); select `ascent_b_site_study.glb`.
- Unreal Engine: Import the `.glb` via a supported glTF workflow, or use the `.obj` geometry.
- Three.js: load GLB with GLTFLoader.

## Limitations
This is a hand-built, **approximate visual study** of one site, not Riot's official map geometry, and its object locations and dimensions should not be used as authoritative for aim/lineups. Reference screenshots: https://www.thespike.gg/valorant/maps/ascent and https://esportsdriven.com/valorant/guides/111/valorant-ascent-map-callouts-guide-with-images.

To recreate an entire map faithfully, source licensed geometry or build and validate it room by room from authorized references.
